# The account types of an Analysis Services server: the standard account types of account intelligence, as the
# Analysis Services Scripting Language names them for an Account. The schema says the list can be extended: a model
# adds an account type of its own in a library of its own, the same as or narrower than one of these.
# name: the type as the schema spells it. number: its place in the schema's list, counted from 0. A server reports
# no code for an account type.
# id: the id of the type in the standard set of the server's types (ServerTypes.SET_URI), a UUID; never changed.
